proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines held passives with an activated planted aura that persists for 10 minutes and applies conditional benefits within an area. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive, activation, triggered_reaction, or composites of those families.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground... While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws...

notes: Held passive alertness and held spell access both fit existing surface shapes, but the planted Protective Aura is not an honest one-shot activation. I did not author Dhall/JSON content or run the tracer to avoid a false trace.
